messages:
eli: Quick flag: new int4 canary (Emerald) shows structured-output parse regressions on /agent/search. rate ~0.8% -> 3.9% after roll. examples incoming.
sasha: link? curious if it's specific to long args or code blocks.
eli: dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/emerald-canary. failures concentrate on queries >100 tokens and multi-line prompts with code fences. sample outputs: ```{
{"tool":"web_search","args":{"q":"redwood inference intro"}}}
{"tool":"web_search","args":{"q":"redwood inference intro"},}
{"tool":"web_search","args":"q=redwood inference intro"}TRAILING
```
ben: looks like trailing-suffix and extra-comma. repro with token dumps int8 vs int4.
priya: mitigation plan: 1) enable tolerant postprocess healer on cohort, label healed responses; 2) disable kv cache for int4 cohort as quick fix; 3) open kernel triage for token/EOS alignment.
ravi: cheap test: disable_kvcache + batch_size=1 tends to drop failures -> do that for cohort B.
ben: repro confirms int8 0.7% vs int4 4.1%. int4+kv_disabled -> ~1.0%. pushing healer with metrics (healer_applied, healer_success).
canary-bot: ALERT: cohort B threshold breached (parse_fail 3.9%). Incident INC-2026-900 created.
eli: pausing further int4 rollout. will run structured-eval (10k golden prompts) to measure schema conformance and report back.
